data.name: add_read_replica
data.description: Add a same-region Cloud SQL read replica for the zonal failure path. Legal even when no_second_region is pinned.

data.name: apply_remediation_plan
data.description: Apply several legal mutations as one all-or-nothing transaction with a single expectedVersion and one version bump.

data.name: clear_all_faults
data.description: Clear every injected latency and packet-loss profile while preserving load, scaling, traffic split, pins, and zone state.

data.name: clear_fault_profile
data.description: Clear injected latency and packet loss from one component or connection.

data.name: fail_component
data.description: Fail a runtime component as a hard outage. Distinct from set_fault_profile dropout, which is packet loss.

data.name: fail_region
data.description: Fail one configured region while keeping its reference topology visible.

data.name: fail_zone
data.description: Fail one configured availability zone while leaving the topology and surviving replicas visible.

data.name: get_architecture
data.description: Read the current semantic topology, health, failures, exclusions, and store version.

data.name: get_bench_guide
data.description: Read the signature human-agent loop, valid remediation paths, pin semantics, and error codes for this bench.

data.name: get_bench_snapshot
data.description: Atomically read scenario, topology, metrics, constraints, RCA, version, tick, and timestamp from one simulation tick.

data.name: get_catalogue_guide
data.description: Read how to pick a catalogue simulation and load it onto the live bench.

data.name: get_constraints
data.description: Read applicable provider-limit and model-assumption records with source dates and provenance.

data.name: get_decision_log
data.description: Read the Flight Data Recorder: recent ui, webmcp, and sim operator events with versions and result codes. Use after STALE_STATE to see why the store version moved. Does not increment storeVersion.

data.name: get_live_metrics
data.description: Read demand, served throughput, capacity, utilisation, traffic share, measurement semantics, traffic-weighted fault contributions, and latency-routing scores with intended versus effective split.

data.name: get_root_cause_analysis
data.description: Explain the current failure using live topology, fault, capacity, SLO, and Flight Data Recorder evidence. Pass unavailableTargets and prohibitedActions when a recovery path is blocked. Returns recommendedActions plus a ready-to-preview remediationPlan when a compound surviving-path recovery is legal.

unavailableTargets.description: Regions, nodes, or edges that cannot be restored or cleared, such as europe-west2.

prohibitedActions.description: Tool names that must not be recommended, such as clear_fault_profile.

data.name: get_scenario
data.description: Read current human scenario controls, targets, pins, and store version.

data.name: get_webmcp_status
data.description: Read WebMCP capability, toolsReady, session id, and registered tool names. Call this before other tools if discovery looks incomplete.

data.name: list_architectures
data.description: List the three equal GCP reference simulations available to load onto the bench.

data.name: load_architecture
data.description: Load a catalogue simulation onto the live bench. Accepts architecture id (event_driven_checkout, multi_region_saas, llm_inference_serving) or a short name such as checkout, saas, or llm. Navigates to /bench/:id.

id.description: Architecture id or short name: checkout, saas, llm, or the full id.

data.name: preview_change
data.description: Read-only projection of a mutation. Does not increment storeVersion. projectionSucceeded is true when the nested op would apply; it is never an applied write.

data.name: ramp_fault_until
data.description: Ramp latencyMs or packetLossPercent from start toward ceiling in steps. Records every intermediate result and stops when the stop condition matches. One version bump. Does not require the agent to issue N stale-checked mutations.

region.description: Optional region alias. When set, ramps set_region_fault_profile instead of a single target.

data.name: reset_scenario
data.description: Reset the loaded reference to its operational baseline: tick 0, stress off, no faults or outages, default load and traffic split. Human pins are kept. Updates the visible topology and gauges.

data.name: restore_component
data.description: Restore a runtime component that was killed or failed.

data.name: restore_region
data.description: Restore one failed region and its placed services.

data.name: restore_zone
data.description: Restore one failed availability zone and its placed replicas.

data.name: run_stress_test
data.description: Start the deterministic stress or failure path for the loaded reference.

data.name: set_autoscaling
data.description: Set autoscaling bounds. Replicas follow demand toward the target utilisation within min/max. When a zone is failed, replacement replicas are placed in surviving zones of the same region.

data.name: set_batching
data.description: Configure batching and wait time for Pub/Sub or Vertex AI within the declared model limits.

data.name: set_budget
data.description: Set the monthly budget constraint in GBP for the current scenario.

data.name: set_fault_profile
data.description: Inject deterministic latency (ms) and packet loss (%) at any declared component or connection. packetLossPercent is the unit-explicit name; dropoutPercent is accepted as an alias.

packetLossPercent.description: Packet loss as a percent of requests (0-100).

data.name: set_latency_based_routing
data.description: Enable or disable latency-based routing. Traffic shifts toward the faster healthy region or sheds a slow release candidate.

data.name: set_model_traffic_split
data.description: Set the release-candidate share of model traffic. The healthy default is a 20% canary.

data.name: set_ordering_key_parallelism
data.description: Set the number of Pub/Sub ordering keys used to spread ordered work while retaining per-key ordering. orderingKeyShards below 1 or unordered=true requests unordered replacement, which keep_pubsub_ordering rejects.

data.name: set_peak_rps
data.description: Set peak load demand in requests per second for the current scenario.

data.name: set_region_fault_profile
data.description: Apply the same latency (ms) and packet loss (%) to a regional boundary. Accepts europe-west2 / West2 / us-east4 / east4. On multi-region SaaS this is the ALB ingress edge, not a guessed node id.

region.description: Region id or alias such as europe-west2, West2, us-east4, east4.

packetLossPercent.description: Packet loss as a percent of requests (0-100).

data.name: set_region_traffic_split
data.description: Set the primary-region traffic allocation.

data.name: stop_stress_test
data.description: Stop the running stress test and leave measured failure state. Use reset_scenario to return the visible bench to baseline.

scenario.referenceSpec: Vertex AI endpoint traffic splits map deployed models to percentages that must total 100; private endpoints do not support traffic splitting.

notes: Node demand, served throughput, and utilisation are instantaneous samples on the current simulation tick.
System latency and availability apply injected faults in proportion to the traffic share of the affected path.
When the bench is not under stress, flow values are the projected routing assignment at the configured peak load.
There is no rolling window: each tick replaces the previous sample.

metrics.faultAccountingNote: Fault contributions describe the current routing assignment. System gauges apply them only while stress is active.
